# Huberman Lab

> A neuroscience-based podcast and resource hub exploring evidence-based protocols for optimizing brain function, physical health, mental well-being, and human performance.

Hosted by Andrew Huberman, a Stanford neuroscientist, Huberman Lab features deep-dive episodes with leading researchers and high-performers across neuroscience, sleep science, fitness, mental health, and longevity. The site curates both episode archives and topic-specific resources for practical implementation of neuroscience findings.

## Key Topics

- Dopamine & Motivation
- Sleep Optimization & Circadian Rhythms
- Neuroplasticity & Learning
- Mental Health (ADHD, OCD, Anxiety)
- Longevity & Aging Biology
- Exercise Physiology & Timing
- Focus & Cognitive Enhancement
- Addiction & Recovery
- Metabolism & Metabolic Health
- Sexual Health & Fertility
- Conflict Resolution
- Neuroscience Fundamentals
- Peak Performance
- Meditation & Mindfulness

## Core Episodes & Archives

- [All Episodes](https://www.hubermanlab.com/all-episodes): Complete archive of all Huberman Lab podcast episodes
- [How Your Brain Works & Changes](https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/how-your-nervous-system-works-and-changes): Nervous system basics, neuroplasticity, and brain function introduction

## Sleep, Circadian Rhythms & Energy

- [Dr. Samer Hattar: Timing Light, Food, & Exercise for Better Sleep, Energy & Mood](https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/dr-samer-hattar-timing-light-food-exercise-for-better-sleep-energy-mood): NIMH scientist on circadian rhythms, light timing, and sleep optimization
- [Circadian Rhythm Biology](https://www.hubermanlab.com/subtopics/circadian-rhythm-biology): Curated resource on circadian rhythms, sleep, and light timing
- [Exercise Timing](https://www.hubermanlab.com/subtopics/exercise-timing): Curated resource on exercise timing and fitness optimization

## Focus, Motivation & Cognitive Performance

- [ADHD & How Anyone Can Improve Their Focus](https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/adhd-and-how-anyone-can-improve-their-focus): ADHD biology, myths, and focus improvement protocols
- [Essentials: How to Increase Motivation & Drive](https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/essentials-how-to-increase-motivation-drive): Dopamine science and practical tools for motivation and focus
- [Dr. Cal Newport: How to Enhance Focus and Improve Productivity](https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/dr-cal-newport-how-to-enhance-focus-and-improve-productivity): Georgetown professor on deep work, focus, and productivity strategies
- [How to Learn More Effectively](https://www.hubermanlab.com/subtopics/how-to-learn-more-effectively): Curated resource on learning optimization and neuroscience-based tools

## Mental Health & Psychological Well-being

- [The Science & Treatment of Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD)](https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/the-science-and-treatment-of-obsessive-compulsive-disorder): OCD biology, psychology, and evidence-based treatment approaches
- [Bill Eddy: How to Deal With High Conflict People](https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/bill-eddy-how-to-deal-with-high-conflict-people): Lawyer and therapist on conflict resolution and managing difficult personalities
- [Addiction](https://www.hubermanlab.com/subtopics/addiction): Curated resource on addiction treatment, recovery, and dopamine regulation

## Longevity, Metabolism & Physical Health

- [Essentials: The Biology of Slowing & Reversing Aging | Dr. David Sinclair](https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/essentials-biology-slowing-reversing-aging-dr-david-sinclair): Harvard scientist on aging biology, longevity, and NAD+ metabolism
- [Essentials: How to Control Your Metabolism by Thyroid & Growth Hormone](https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/essentials-how-to-control-your-metabolism-by-thyroid-growth-hormone): Thyroid and growth hormone effects on metabolism and body composition
- [Dr. Michael Eisenberg: Improving Male Sexual Health, Function & Fertility](https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/dr-michael-eisenberg-improving-male-sexual-health-function-fertility): Stanford urologist discusses male sexual health, fertility, and reproductive biology
- [AMA #19: Collagen vs. Whey Protein, Creatine, Smelling Salts, Stimulants & More](https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/ama-19-collagen-vs-whey-protein-creatine-smelling-salts-stimulants): Q&A episode on protein, creatine, and supplement comparison
- [Diabetes & Obesity](https://www.hubermanlab.com/subtopics/diabetes-obesity): Curated resource on metabolic health, blood sugar, and obesity management

## Peak Performance & Personal Development

- [Josh Waitzkin: The Art of Learning & Living Life](https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/josh-waitzkin-the-art-of-learning-living-life): Chess prodigy and martial artist on learning, resilience, and peak performance
- [Tony Hawk: Harnessing Passion, Drive & Persistence for Lifelong Success](https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/tony-hawk-harnessing-passion-drive-and-persistence-for-lifelong-success): Skateboarding legend on passion, persistence, and entrepreneurship
- [Dr. Lex Fridman: Navigating Conflict, Finding Purpose & Maintaining Drive](https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/dr-lex-fridman-navigating-conflict-finding-purpose-and-maintaining-drive): Lex Fridman discusses conflict, purpose, and drive with AI/robotics expertise
